text.html: Logistics & Shipping to the United States
text.text: Logistics & Shipping to the United States

text.html:
We structure our U.S. bulk matcha supply through a hybrid logistics model designed for reliability, flexibility, and scale.

Direct Shipment from Origin
We ship bulk matcha powder directly from our certified production partners in Japan and China to the United States via air freight or sea freight, depending on volume and urgency.

This ensures:
- Full traceability from source
- Batch-specific documentation
- Fresh production alignment
- Structured palletized export shipments

All export documentation and compliance paperwork is prepared to align with U.S. import requirements.

U.S. Warehousing & Local Availability
In addition to direct international shipments, we hold U.S. stock in our warehouse in Salt Lake City, Utah, and ship from there across the United States in 2–4 days. Our U.S. team works from our office in Los Angeles. Fulfillment is handled with our logistics partner Fidelity.

This allows:
- Faster domestic fulfillment
- Reduced lead times
- Improved supply continuity
- Flexible re-order scheduling
- Buffer stock availability for recurring clients

For long-term partners, we can structure rolling inventory programs within the U.S. to stabilize supply planning and reduce operational risk.

Structured Supply for U.S. Buyers
We support:
- Annual volume agreements
- Recurring pallet programs
- Split shipments (origin + U.S. stock)
- Flexible restocking models

This dual-origin + U.S. warehousing approach ensures supply security for:
- Supplement brands
- Beverage manufacturers
- Distributors
- Private label operators

Lead Times
Lead times depend on where your order ships from:
- U.S. stock (Salt Lake City warehouse): delivered in 2–4 days anywhere in the U.S.
- Direct air freight: faster turnaround for urgent production
- Sea freight pallet programs: optimized for cost efficiency

Our team works with procurement departments to align delivery schedules with production planning cycles.
‍
